neet_che_u14_t02_1.working: Adjacent members of a homologous series differ by one CH2 unit, which has mass 12 + 2 = 14 u.

neet_che_u14_t02_2.working: HCOOH and CH3COOH have the same functional group (–COOH) and differ by exactly one CH2, so they are homologues. The other pairs either have different functional groups or do not differ by CH2.

neet_che_u14_t02_4.working: A is true because both alcohols have the same functional group. R is true because boiling point rises with molecular mass. However, a trend in boiling point does not explain why chemical properties are similar.

neet_che_u14_t02_5.working: Cyclohexane C6H12 fits CnH2n, not CnH2n−2, so Statement I is false. Alcohol solubility in water falls as the hydrophobic chain lengthens, so Statement II is true.
